cv.adaptation: Twelve monthly blocks assembled from actual daily library folds; refit once each month and predict h1 each day, not366 independent refits or month-ahead predictions. The same supplied train/inner/validation indices feed real model optimization.

preprocessing.absolute_log: V1 pointwise logOHLC/log1pV,channelmeanstd over unique train inputdays
preprocessing.relative_window: logOHLC-loglastobservedclose per window,log1pV,channelmeanstd over all train-windowpositions; transform changes weighting of repeated positions too

selection_policy: No new HPO, D search, or replacement of V1 reference identity. FixedV1width/LR to compare preprocessing and actual expanding CV; any V2leader is descriptive on exposed2024.

training.refit: Fresh model on allowed full2023 cohort for the best inner epoch count; no warm start

seed_policy: Same ten base seeds across models/variants; actualmonthseed=baseseed+monthordinal*100000; freshrefitseed=monthseed+10000000; stage shuffle seed+17
repetitions_scope: Ten independent training-randomization trajectories per model/variant, exploratory resource-bounded CV; not a pilot-derived0.8power design, folds are not extra markets.

analysis.primary: Pooled2024RMSE per fulltrajectory,then mean across seeds; R2 on pooled2024targets, not a mean of single-dateR2 or weightedmonthlyR2
analysis.secondary_common_cohort: Jul-Dec184dates descriptive comparison to original V1 whose seeds/data-selection scheme differ; do not pair different seeds
analysis.paired_tests: relative_window-minus-absolute_log meanRMSE difference for each of3models, ten matched seeds, t95 marginalCI and Holm3 exploratory conditionalcalendar; R2difference descriptiveCI
